back: Safety and obstacle clearance. Follow ATC and published routes.

back: High approach; minimum practicable power; late descent/configuration; established route.

back: Altitude, IAS, rate of climb or rate of descent.

back: Avoid take-off and landing during their passage.

front: What should not be improvised inside a microburst?
back: Do not retract gear/flaps, turn to escape or chase speed abruptly. Use POH/AFM.

back: Pressure equalises around wingtips; airflow curls into counter-rotating vortices.

back: Heavy, clean, slow.

back: The slower aircraft.

back: Greater weight → stronger wake.

back: They descend, drift with wind and may persist after aircraft passes.

back: When the preceding aircraft lifts off its nosewheel.

back: If possible rotate before its rotation point; climb above its path.

back: A vortex may remain on or near the runway.

back: Brake moderately; maintain directional control aerodynamically.

back: Maintain control; avoid abrupt manoeuvres; assess damage; advise ATC.
